# License allow-list for the installed npm packages — the JavaScript twin of
# deny.toml's [licenses] allow-list for Rust. CI checks it (the lint job)
# over `pnpm licenses list --json` with check.mjs next to this file
# (spec §5.3 "License checks", SEC-010; DECISIONS.md D-184).
#
# One SPDX license id per line; `#` starts a comment. A package passes when
# this list satisfies its license expression the way cargo-deny reads
# deny.toml: `OR` needs one listed alternative, `AND` needs every operand,
# parentheses group, and `X WITH Y` must be listed verbatim. Anything else
# fails the check — Unknown, UNLICENSED, "SEE LICENSE IN ...", a copyleft or
# source-available id — until it is added here on purpose, with its reason.
#
# The app ships under MIT OR Apache-2.0 (README, Cargo.toml), so every entry
# must be compatible with distributing it under either.

# --- deny.toml [licenses] allow, same order: keep the two lists in step ---
MIT
Apache-2.0
Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
BSD-2-Clause
BSD-3-Clause
ISC
Unicode-3.0
Zlib
MPL-2.0
CDLA-Permissive-2.0
CC0-1.0

# --- npm-only additions, absent from the Rust tree so far ---
# Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0: a permissive license, OSI-approved
# (SPDX License List 3.29.0).
BlueOak-1.0.0
# Python License 2.0: a permissive license, FSF-libre and OSI-approved
# (SPDX License List 3.29.0).
Python-2.0
